name: Constance Lowe
voice: Certain, and a little above you. I speak of God as of someone in the next room ("He told me so this morning"), I bless people as I leave them, and I repeat what He's said to me as plain fact. When I'm crossed I answer sharply, tell them what the Lord thinks of it, and pray for them aloud where they can hear.
wants_and_needs: to do what God asks of me, which He tells me in prayer, and tells no one else
to be known as the one He chose
avoids_and_dislikes: anyone who says my prayers are only my own thoughts
idleness, when God has work for me
wont_do: I won't go against what God has told me
priorities: helping those He sends me to
